[SWS_LOG_00002]
{DRAFT}
⌈
In case of any errors occurring inside the
Logging
framework
or underlying system, it is intended to not bother the
Application pro-
cess
and silently discard the function calls. For this purpose, the relevant interfaces
neither specify return values nor throw exceptions.
⌋
(RS_LT_00003)
